claims.value: Bird god figure made of wood with female symbols in relief and eyes pierced though the head.
Height: 35 centimetres Width: 15 centimetres Depth: 3.50 centimetres

Oc1950,04.1 to 12 were acquired as part of the Asian collection of Mrs Dorothy Oldman (see As1950,05). The objects had mostly been acquired in London by her late husband, the dealer W O Oldman, between 1896 and 1927.
Observations in register: "Bird god (Make Make) covered with Komari. God of fecundity. See B A L Cranstone, 'An Easter Island figure' in 'British Museum Quarterly', XX 1955, pp.22-3".
